name: @nuri/prototype
description: Nuri prototype · the build-free web library: the web factory + the primitives + the 3 factory-backed recipes + nuri-demo + reset.css, and the namespace-CSS generation (reads @nuri/spec's TS SoTs → emits styles/<ns>.css). The prototyping mirror of @nuri/rn (decision 68 · package-architecture.md §3.2 · convergence phase 2 · the A3 carve).
//: build-free in the browser (custom elements + CSS · zero build · loaded in place by @nuri/doc + @nuri/playground). The ONLY build step is the namespace-CSS GENERATOR (pipeline/css-preview.js · post-flip prototype OWNS it · decision 74): it reads spec's axis SoTs (resolve-map / property-spelling / palette-surface / interactive-effects / typography-axis · via the @nuri/spec exports map) + spec's generated styles/tokens-semantic.css (scale vocab · cross-package) and writes the 5 generated namespace CSS into styles/. The output is committed + CI-guarded (re-emit ≡ committed · the 4 pipeline/*.test.js). DAG: prototype → spec (no spec → prototype read). postcss is a devDep ONLY because the 4 namespace freshness tests parse with it (the emitters are dep-free node).
